s.g: A member of a Central Asian Turkic ethnic group native to Uzbekistan and neighboring countries, with significant, centuries-old indigenous populations across northern Afghanistan, Tajikistan, and Kyrgyzstan.
Of, from, or pertaining to Uzbekistan, the Uzbek people or the Uzbek language.
A country in Central Asia. Official name: Republic of Uzbekistan. Capital: Tashkent.
A type of compact submachine gun, having a caliber of 9 millimeters with ammunition housed in the grip of the weapon.
